SELECT s.attachment_selection_id,
 s.quote_id,
 s.product_code,
 s.model_code,
 s.attachment_price_id,
 s.item_name,
 s.variant,
 s.price_source,
 s.quantity,
 s.unit_price,
 s.price_text,
 s.cost_method,
 COALESCE(s.unit_price, p.price) AS effective_unit_price,
 CASE
 WHEN (COALESCE(s.unit_price, p.price) IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
 ELSE round(((s.quantity * COALESCE(s.unit_price, p.price)) * (s.price_sign)::numeric), 2)
 END AS line_cost,
 s.notes,
 s.created_at,
 s.updated_at,
 s.price_sign
 FROM (calc.attachment_selection s
 LEFT JOIN calc.attachment_price p ON ((p.attachment_price_id = s.attachment_price_id)));

SELECT attachment_price_id,
 attachment_category,
 item_name,
 model_code,
 variant,
 material_code,
 width_mm,
 height_mm,
 depth_mm,
 unit,
 price,
 price_text,
 price_source,
 notes,
 source_file,
 source_sheet,
 source_row_no,
 effective_from,
 effective_to,
 is_active,
 created_at,
 updated_at,
 cost_method
 FROM calc.attachment_price
 WHERE (is_active = true);

SELECT p.attachment_price_id,

 p.width_mm,
 p.height_mm,
 p.depth_mm,
 p.unit,
 p.price,
 p.price_text,
 p.price_source,
 p.notes,
 p.source_file,
 p.source_sheet,
 p.source_row_no,
 p.effective_from,
 p.effective_to,
 p.is_active,
 p.created_at,
 p.updated_at,
 p.cost_method,
 c.category_level1,
 c.category_level2,
 c.category_level3,
 c.classification_source,
 c.updated_at AS classification_updated_at
 FROM (calc.attachment_price p
 LEFT JOIN calc.attachment_classification c ON ((c.attachment_price_id = p.attachment_price_id)));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calc.calculate_total_cost_for_quote(p_quote_id character varying, p_corrected_material_weight_kg numeric, p_material_price_per_kg numeric, p_auxiliary_cost numeric DEFAULT 0, p_labor_cost numeric DEFAULT 0, p_spray_cost numeric DEFAULT 0, p_product_code character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying)
 RETURNS TABLE(material_cost numeric, auxiliary_cost numeric, labor_cost numeric, attachment_fee numeric, spray_cost numeric, management_fee numeric, total_cost numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT *
 FROM calc.calculate_total_cost_by_spray_cost(
 p_corrected_material_weight_kg,
 p_material_price_per_kg,
 p_auxiliary_cost,
 p_labor_cost,
 calc.get_attachment_fee(p_quote_id, p_product_code),
 p_spray_cost
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calc.get_attachment_fee(p_quote_id character varying, p_product_code character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(v.line_cost), 2), 0)
 FROM calc.v_attachment_selection_cost v
 WHERE v.quote_id = p_quote_id
 AND (p_product_code IS NULL OR v.product_code = p_product_code);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calc.get_attachment_price(p_model_code character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying, p_item_name character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying, p_width_mm integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_height_mm integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_depth_mm integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_variant character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying, p_price_source character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT ap.price
 FROM calc.attachment_price ap
 WHERE ap.is_active = TRUE
 AND ap.price IS NOT NULL
 AND (p_model_code IS NULL OR ap.model_code = p_model_code OR ap.model_code IS NULL OR ap.model_code = '所有型号')
 AND (p_item_name IS NULL OR ap.item_name = p_item_name)
 AND (p_width_mm IS NULL OR ap.width_mm = p_width_mm)
 AND (p_height_mm IS NULL OR ap.height_mm = p_height_mm)
 AND (p_depth_mm IS NULL OR ap.depth_mm = p_depth_mm)
 AND (p_variant IS NULL OR ap.variant = p_variant OR ap.variant IS NULL)
 AND (p_price_source IS NULL OR ap.price_source = p_price_source)
 ORDER BY
 CASE WHEN ap.model_code = p_model_code THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
 CASE WHEN ap.item_name = p_item_name THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
 ap.attachment_price_id DESC
 LIMIT 1;
$function$
